name: convai-character-authoring
description: Create, edit, review and release Convai characters.

interface.longDescription: Author and manage conversational characters for games and virtual worlds on Convai. Sign in with your Convai account to list and inspect your characters, create new ones, edit backstory, voice, language and narrative design, compare draft and released versions, release or roll back versions, and connect existing knowledge bank documents. The plugin only accesses characters and documents in your Convai account, and every change is confirmed before it is written. It does not upload knowledge documents or run function code; use the Convai dashboard for those.
defaultPrompt: List my Convai characters and summarize each one in a sentence.
Create a Convai character named Captain Mira, a retired starship pilot who runs a spaceport cafe.
What changed in my character's draft since the last released version?
